sticky.$description: Sticky chrome in the normal layer: TopHeader, PageLayout sticky regions.

pinned.$description: Pinned app chrome and full-viewport app surfaces: SideNav overlay, BottomDrawer, PageNav, StickyActions, a full-screen canvas.

popover.$description: Normal-layer popovers: Menu, Autocomplete listbox, Select, ContextMenu, tooltips.

modal.$description: Modals that do not use the native top layer.

toast.$description: Snackbars and toasts, above non-top-layer modals.
